title: A note on even Clifford algebras of skew quadric hypersurfaces
summary: Let $S_α= k\langle x_1,\dots,x_n\rangle /(x_i x_j - α_{ij} x_j x_i)$ be a standard graded skew polynomial algebra over an algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic not equal to $2$. We show the following results. When $n$ is odd and $f = x_1x_2 + \cdots + x_{n-2}x_{n-1} + x_n^2$ is a normal element of $S_α$, the even Clifford algebra of the skew quadric hypersurface $S_α/(f)$ is isomorphic to a full matrix algebra $M_{2^{(n-1)/2}}(k)$, and the stable category $\underline{\mathsf{CM}}^{\mathbb Z}(S_α/(f))$ of graded maximal Cohen-Macaulay modules over $S_α/(f)$ is triangle equivalent…
